visual_readings.visual_observation: Unlabelled nearly circular open outline joined to a short handle ending in a small loop. Read in place with requested fly pincers; no scale, dimensions or precise mechanical construction inferred from sketch.

Arched double outline with central dotted course. Left label under and I suppose thin membrane of carapace points to inner boundary; right label upper and thick membrane of carapace points to outer boundary. Supports Darwin’s stated proposed corium distinction, not a measured observation.

Longitudinal folded form: old carapace outer lines, new carapace dashed inner lines, dotted middle corium; heavy outer saddle above and inner saddle below. Labels and paired membrane relationships actually visible. Schematic suggestion for clarity, not the later published plate.

Truncated body at left has a row of short vertebral marks continuing into a narrow upward/projecting upper tail lobe; rounded larger lobe below. No scale or labels. Illustrates Dana report of juvenile gar-pike tail and proposed later loss of upper extension, not direct proof of a universal developmental law.

reading_method: Root independently read complete surviving new source bodies, metadata constraints, exclusions, footnotes, scholarly sections and bibliography. Actual special markup and figures inspected where present. Reused explicit accepted primary readings only after matching source and accepted evidence hashes. Historical decisions and notes are handwritten; validation packages evidence rather than adjudicating it.
